commitResults.messageTitle: Updated .gitignore, AGENTS.md, and changed the bot name to MoistBot
Updated MoistBot to greet and exit. Updated README to reflect changes
Add user input echo and exit functionality with SEEDU documentation
commitResults.messageBody:
- Implement Scanner-based input loop that echoes user messages
- Add exit condition when user types bye
- Add comprehensive Javadoc for class and main method

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor MoistBot to support task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody:
- Extract banner and divider as static constants to reduce duplication
- Move user input handling into a new parseInput() method
- Integrate task list functionality with list command support
- Allow tasks to be added by any non-bye input
- Update class documentation to reflect task management capability

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Task class and mark/unmark functionality
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Task class to represent individual tasks with completion
status, replacing the string-based storage model. This enables
users to mark tasks as completed or incomplete via new mark and
unmark commands.

Changes:
- Create Task class with name and completion status
- Refactor List to store Task objects instead of strings
- Rename List methods: addText() → addTask(), printText() → printTasks()
- Add List.getTask(int id) to retrieve tasks by index
- Implement mark and unmark commands in parseInput()
- Improve command parsing to handle input arguments
- Update Javadoc comments to reflect new design

commitResults.messageTitle: Rename task manager class Rename the in-memory task list helper from List to TaskManager and update the references in MoistBot to match. This keeps the class name clearer and makes the task management role more explicit.

Refactor input handling into Command and Parser classes Extract input parsing and command handling logic from MoistBot into two new classes: Parser handles normalization and validation, Command encapsulates parsed command data. Update MoistBot to use these classes for clearer separation of concerns and easier maintenance.

Refactor UI and error handling into dedicated components Introduce UserInterface class to centralize all output formatting, separating presentation logic from command execution. Migrate error handling from Parser's error commands to exception-based approach, allowing MoistBot to catch and display errors via UI layer. Update Task and TaskManager to provide data accessors instead of printing directly, completing the inversion of control pattern where UI layer owns all output responsibility.

Refactor command parsing to use enum-based types and structured fields - Replace generic String-based command representation with CommandType enum - Add specialized fields (description, from, to) to Command class for different command needs - Implement dedicated parsers for deadline and event commands with validation - Add task type constants (TODO, DEADLINE, EVENT) to Task class - Update all command consumers to work with new enum-based architecture - Enhance error messages for missing or malformed arguments
commitResults.messageBody: This improves type safety and makes command handling more maintainable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor command handling and task creation Extract command-specific parsing and execution helpers to make the command flow easier to read and maintain.
commitResults.messageBody:
Centralise task creation and storage, make immutable task data final,
and update mark/unmark feedback and UI regression cases to reflect the
revised behaviour.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor command processing in MoistBot
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract command parsing and error handling into processCommand() to
simplify the main loop. Rename the exit flag for clearer boolean naming
and use the simplified task-list UI method.

commitResults.messageTitle: Report unrecognized commands as errors
Add invalid-input UI regression tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Cover malformed task additions and invalid mark or unmark commands.
Verify that rejected commands preserve task list and completion state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add custom exception for chatbot errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Use MoistBotException for invalid commands, task operations, and
task-list capacity failures so chatbot-specific errors are handled
consistently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Strengthen AI agent testing procedure
commitResults.messageBody:
Require agents to update relevant UI test cases and invoke the
test-ui skill after every code update.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve command error handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Give users specific guidance for malformed commands, invalid task
numbers, missing task fields, and task-list capacity failures.

Reject unexpected arguments and malformed separators so invalid input
does not silently proceed. Add a fallback for unexpected runtime errors
to keep the application responsive.

Expand UI regression coverage for each error path and the 100-task
limit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve empty list feedback
commitResults.messageBody:
Explain that the task list is empty and show the available commands
when the user runs list without any tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine MoistBot’s courteous user messages
commitResults.messageBody:
Update greetings, confirmations, validation errors, and unexpected-error
messages to use a clear, professional butler voice. Refresh UI regression
cases and documentation to reflect the revised console output.

Also make stateless utility classes non-instantiable and improve selected
Javadoc and naming details.
